fusions.name: Bulk Unleashed
fusions.desc: You rear up and drop your full bulk, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Maul and Toss
fusions.desc: A mauling horn strike that deals 14 damage, makes the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds and tosses it back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Highland Shag
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 30% for 10 seconds. You also carry 10% frost resistance.

fusions.name: Fattened for Winter
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 15, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
